stories.title: Garden City: Northern Gateway housing scheme falls short of 20% affordable homes target
stories.summary: Four hundred homes being built at Northern Gateway in Garden City were approved with no affordable housing, a council monitoring report shows. The council’s own policy asks for 20% in the area. The figures are in Flintshire’s third annual monitoring report on its Local Development Plan. stories.title: Flu vaccine kept 800 people out of hospital in Wales last winter

stories.title: Caergwrle church solar panels face refusal two years after conservation area halt
stories.summary: Sub: Councillor and community council back the Methodist church’s net zero plans, but conservation officers say the panels would harm the village’s historic streetscape. stories.title: Flintshire Council enforcement team issued just two dog fouling fines last year
stories.summary: Flintshire Council’s enforcement team issued just two fines for dog fouling in 2025/26, figures show, as the council prepares to renew its dog control rules.
